Messages.Author: Steinar
Messages.Body:
Faerie Wards [HttB:C]
Cardtype: Reaction
Cost: 2 blood
Discipline: Mytherceria / Auspex
Only usable when an ally or younger vampire is taking a  action against you.
[aus] +2 intercept.
[myt] The action fails. Tap this reacting vampire.
[MYT] As [myt] above, and the acting minion does not untap as normal during his or her next untap phase.
Artist: Aaron Acevedo

I have a question about this card. "Only usable when an ally or younger vampire is taking a  action against you." Does this count as only me, the methuselah, or my minions as well?

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Steinar wrote:
> I have a question about this card. "Only usable when an ally or younger vampire is taking a  action against you." Does this count as only me, the methuselah, or my minions as well?
>
Actions against cards you control are actions against you (that's why you don't need an Eagle Sight to declare block attempts).
Rulebook 6.2.2 wrote:
>
> Who May Attempt to Block: If the action targets one or more other Methuselahs (or things controlled by other Methuselahs), then the action is called directed, and only the Methuselahs who are targeted (or control the targets) may use their ready untapped minions to attempt to block the action (going clockwise from the acting Methuselah, as usual).
>

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: Weird, I got a Kunena error there..
